# DB-4A.1 — Verified FED Rename Map (audit/data-prep only; no code/seed/images/plan changed)

## Why DB-4B.1 was halted

DB-4B.1 needed a trustworthy `oldAURONname -> FEDcanonicalName` map to rename **default templates** and
**live user Plan rows**. The previous `docs/db4a_plan_name_migration.csv` was generated by a token-overlap
matcher with incomplete conflict detection, so its `FED_RENAME` column contained unsafe matches and
collisions that would have **corrupted user Plan data**, e.g.:
`Barbell Flat Bench Press → Barbell Guillotine Bench Press`,
`Diamond Push-Up` & `Pike Push-Up` & `Push-Up → Pushups` (collision),
`Forearm Plank` & `Side Plank → Plank` (collision),
`T-Bar Row → Lying T-Bar Row`, `Wide-Grip Pull-Up → Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up`,
`Cable Lateral Raise → Cable Seated Lateral Raise`, `Dumbbell Goblet Squat → Dumbbell Squat`.

This task regenerates a **strict, verified** map.

## Method (strict, conservative — no false positives)

A mapping is `SAFE_RENAME` only when **all** hold:
1. **Equipment matches** (checked via the FED `equipment` field, not the name).
2. **No protected variant keyword differs** between the two names — guard list includes:
   incline/decline/flat/guillotine/lying/seated/standing/kneeling/rear/front/side/wide/close/diamond/pike/
   goblet/sissy/pistol/smith/single/sumo/deficit/preacher/reverse/behind/rack/rope/overhead/hammer/cross/
   floor/hack/trap/chest-supported/landmine/bicycle/pulley/bent-arm/clock/… (any defining variant → REVIEW).
3. The FED name is the **same or more specific**, where the only allowed extra descriptors are a tiny
   whitelist (`medium`, `grip`, `military`, `standard`). **Generic-izing a specific exercise is never SAFE**
   (e.g. Bicycle Crunch → Crunches is rejected).
4. Match is by **exact normalized tokenset** (plural/word-order/hyphen normalized, equipment words
   stripped), a **curator-declared alias**, or the whitelisted-superset rule.
5. The FED target **exists in the SUPPORTED_STRENGTH set** (515).
6. **No collision** — two old names may never map to the same FED name (collisions are demoted to REVIEW).

## Results

| Classification | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **SAFE_RENAME** | **63** | exact same exercise — safe to rename templates + active Plan rows |
| **REVIEW_REQUIRED** | **62** | a candidate exists but a variant/setup/equipment differs — human decides, **do not auto-rename** |
| **KEEP_CUSTOM / DELETE_FROM_CATALOG_ONLY** | **30** | no safe FED equivalent — drop from the FED-first catalog; **keep Plan rows as custom** (engine name-inference) |
| **Collisions** | **0** | none in SAFE output |

- Total old AURON curated names reviewed: **155** (63 + 62 + 30).
- Of the 19 distinct **default-template** exercise names, **13 are SAFE_RENAME**; the other 6 are
  REVIEW/CUSTOM (e.g. `Dumbbell Hammer Curl`, `Pec Deck Machine Fly`) and should be **removed from
  built-in templates** in DB-4B rather than renamed (or renamed only after manual confirmation).

Output files:
- `docs/db4a1_verified_rename_map.csv` — the **63 SAFE_RENAME** rows (use this for DB-4B).
- `docs/db4a1_rejected_or_review_mappings.csv` — the **92** REVIEW + KEEP_CUSTOM rows with reasons.

## DB-4B retry instructions

DB-4B may now proceed **using only `docs/db4a1_verified_rename_map.csv` (the 63 SAFE_RENAME rows)** for:
- renaming the default templates (13 of 19; remove the other 6 from built-in templates), and
- the one-time, flag-guarded **active Plan row** name normalization.

For `REVIEW_REQUIRED` (62) and `KEEP_CUSTOM` (30): **do not rename** Plan rows; in the FED-first catalog
those AURON-only entries are simply absent (engine falls back to name-inference for any Plan exercise on
those names — acceptable, same as a user's custom exercise). Catalog itself is rebuilt directly from the
515 SUPPORTED_STRENGTH FED set (independent of this map). Preserve History; drafts are id-keyed.

## Confirmation

No code, seed, images, Room schema, Plan, or History were changed. Only three docs were written
(`db4a1_verified_rename_map.csv`, `db4a1_rejected_or_review_mappings.csv`, this report).
